verdict.rationale: ADK's own CLI runs an agent folder from the terminal with `adk run path/to/my_agent`. It also runs bundled samples headlessly against evalsets via `adk eval samples_for_testing/hello_world ...`, and `adk api_server` exposes agents over REST 'for programmatic testing', so an agent can verify what it built without the web UI. missing for 10: prose documentation of `adk run`'s non-interactive/scripted input and output behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven headless verification.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can run the framework's example agents headlessly from a terminal so an agent can verify what it just built

citations.quote: Use the API server in ADK to expose your agents through a REST API for programmatic testing
